capture_status_detail: No profile data could be retrieved from Instagram or any public mirror without logging in. Every field below that is null was not observed; none of it is fabricated. See README.md for the per-route HTTP evidence.

username_resolution_evidence.summary: Instagram's own server-rendered HTML shell for /aluzina.espacios/ (fetched unauthenticated, HTTP 200, 626 KB, 2026-09-21T04:01Z) carries polarisRouteConfig.pageID = 'httpErrorPage', root component 'PolarisErrorRoot', props page_type 'PROFILE' and show_lox_redesigned_404_page = true. That is the shell Instagram serves for a profile URL it cannot resolve. A same-session control fetch of a known-live profile could not be completed because Instagram began answering 429 to every request from this egress (see README). Treat 'username does not exist / was renamed' as the leading but not fully confirmed explanation.
username_resolution_evidence.mirror_insta_stories_viewer_com: Page for aluzina.espacios rendered 0 Posts / 0 Followers / 0 Following and the string 'An account with this login does not exist' (the page also contains its other generic error strings, so it is weak evidence on its own).
username_resolution_evidence.search_engines: WebSearch (two queries) and a Bing "aluzina.espacios" site:instagram.com query returned no instagram.com/aluzina.espacios result (Bing returned 7 unrelated non-instagram pages). DuckDuckGo answered with a bot-challenge page (HTTP 202), no data. All Instagram results WebSearch returned for the company point to instagram.com/aluzinaa.
username_resolution_evidence.company_website: https://aluzinaa.com/ links only to https://www.instagram.com/aluzinaa/ (link texts 'Síguenos', 'Ver Instagram'); see bio_link_site.json.
username_resolution_evidence.repo: /workspace/aluzina README and seed data name the public site aluzinaa.com and the Instagram channel but do not mention the handle aluzina.espacios.
